definition_zh: 有抱负的；渴望的；求职者；候选人
definition_en: aiming for a high position or goal, or a person who seeks such a position
core_image: 盯着录取名单、眼里有光的年轻人
scene: 考场上，每个屏息落笔的人都盼着金榜题名。Each aspirant waited outside the office for the final interview.
sceneCN: 这里 aspirant 是名词「候选人、有志者」（第 2 个义项：谋求高位的人）；句意是每位候选人在办公室外等待最终面试。

derivatives.zh: 同根动词（拉丁语 aspirare），义为「渴望；追求」
同根名词，义为「志向；渴望」
由 aspiration 派生，义为「有雄心壮志的」

senses.title: Full of ambition
senses.definition: ambitious and striving toward a goal or high position
senses.definitionCN: 怀有雄心、朝目标或高位努力
senses.example: The studio is full of aspirant directors shooting short films.
senses.exampleCN: 工作室里挤满了拍摄短片的、雄心勃勃的准导演。
senses.why: Latin aspirare meant to breathe toward; ambition was imagined as breath reaching toward a goal.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 aspirare 意为朝…呼气；雄心被想象为向目标呼出的气息。

senses.title: A person seeking advancement
senses.definition: one who seeks a position, honor, or office
senses.definitionCN: 谋求职位、荣誉或官职的人
senses.example: Party aspirants competed for the nomination.
senses.why: When the striving is personified, the adjective becomes the noun for the striver.
senses.whyCN: 当这种奋斗被拟人化，形容词就名词化为「奋斗者」。

intro.en: Aspirant comes from Latin aspirare, to breathe toward, formed of ad- plus spirare, to breathe.
intro.cn: aspirant 源自拉丁语 aspirare（向…呼气），由 ad-（朝向）加 spirare（呼吸）构成。

items.en: The root *speis- meant to blow or breathe.
Spirare meant to breathe, giving spirit, inspire, respire.
items.cn: 拉丁语 spirare 意为呼吸，派生 spirit、inspire、respire。

items.en: Aspirare meant to breathe on or toward, later to seek eagerly.
items.cn: aspirare 意为向…吹气，后引申为热切追求。

items.en: Aspirer kept the figurative pursuit sense.
items.cn: 古法语 aspirer 保留追求的比喻义。

items.en: English formed the noun aspirant for a seeker of high office.
items.cn: 十八至十九世纪英语由之构成名词 aspirant，指谋求高位者。

note.en: Aspirant names the person behind the verb aspire: the one still climbing.
note.cn: aspirant 是动词 aspire 背后的人：那个仍在攀登的人。

entries.definition: to breathe out, hence to end

entries.definitionCN: 钦佩（后缀相似，词根不同）

entries.definition: one who seeks an office or position
one who tries to find or obtain
one making a claim, as to a title
a person likely to succeed, informal

normalIntro.en: See aspire inside: an aspirant is one who aspires, still out of breath from climbing.
normalIntro.cn: aspir（aspire 渴望）+ ant（者）：仍在攀爬、喘着气追梦的人。

normal.en: spirare is breath: spirit, inspire, respire.
ad- + spirare: breathe toward a goal.
normal.cn: ad- + spirare：向目标呼气，即追求。

normal.en: -ant turns the verb into the person.
expire breathes out, ends; aspire breathes toward.
normal.cn: expire 呼出即终结；aspire 朝向即追求。

normal.en: an aspirant has not yet arrived.

abstract.en: Picture lungs filling before a sprint.
abstract.cn: 想象冲刺前深深吸气的肺。

abstract.en: See names on a shortlist, one circled in red.
abstract.cn: 看见入围名单上一个被红笔圈起的名字。

abstract.en: Feel the upward pull of a summit above clouds.

examples.en: Every aspirant dreamed of playing at the nationals.
examples.cn: 每位有志者都梦想参加全国大赛。

examples.en: The think tank hired several aspirant economists.
examples.cn: 智库聘用了几位雄心勃勃的青年经济学者。

examples.en: Aspirants for the scholarship submitted essays in March.
examples.cn: 奖学金申请者三月份提交了论文。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「饿斯派任特」——饿着也派自己去任重职，正是 aspirant 的进取心。

root: 拉丁语 ad-（朝向）+ spirare（呼吸）→ aspirare「向目标呼气、热望」，后缀 -ant 表人。

sensesIntro.en: Breathing toward becomes striving for, and the striver becomes a noun.
sensesIntro.cn: 「向之呼气」化为「为之奋斗」，奋斗者进而名词化。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: breath drawn toward a summit still out of reach
core.cn: 核心意象：朝尚未企及的山峰呼出的气息

branches.en: climbing that is not yet done

branches.cn: 早期职业生涯背后的动力

intro.en: The spirare family spreads through English words of breath, life, and ambition.
intro.cn: spirare 词族遍布英语中关于呼吸、生命与抱负的词。

latinIntro.en: Latin spirare anchors one of English's most productive roots.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 spirare 是英语最高产的词根之一。

items.meaning: to breathe through, hence to happen
